text:
Maya: FYI ran the q8x4-int8 canary on the multi-language translation cohort. seeing high variance on Spanish<>English paraphrase prompts where our refset has many near-duplicates. looks like tokenization boundary shifts after quantized vocab packing. need a quick plan to dedupe and pick new golds. @Omar @Priya can you look?

Omar: ugh that tokenization packing difference again. can you paste a couple examples so we can see if it's paraphrase vs stage-of-dialog?

Maya: quick examples: 
```
1) "Translate this customer support thread into Spanish and summarize action items."
2) "Spanish translation + action list for the following support chat."
3) "Make a Spanish summary with bullets from this support transcript."
```
All same intent but slightly different scaffolding. hashed differently so dedupe missed them.

Priya: propose pipeline tweak: normalize templates + remove stop-prefix tokens before hashing, then do embedding clustering for fuzzy matches. For clustering threshold I'd start 0.86 for multilingual SBERT.

Jin: also include a length-aware penalty in the cluster scoring. long transcripts that truncate differently can look dissimilar.

Kevin: from a labeling ops side: let's avoid huge manual effort. we should triage clusters by measured quality delta between fp16 and int8 first, then prioritize label reviews.

Maya: I ran a quick micro-eval: qb-4012 shows mean BLEU -1.5 but 9% of prompts >6 BLEU drop and those map tightly to high-overlap clusters.

eval-bot: qbench run qb-4012 completed. link: https://internal.redwood/qbench/qb-4012. csv attached.

Omar: estimate for full embed pass on promptbank (~1.2M): ~1.6 v100-days. if we shard 16 ways we can finish embeddings in ~5h. clustering another 2h. total wall ~7h.

Priya: I'll prepare the export for LabelOps with these columns: cluster_id, lang_pair, exemplar_prompts, tokenized_len_fp16, tokenized_len_int8, avg_bleu_delta, suggested_action. I'll stage CSV at s3://redwood-curation/q8x4_translation_triage.csv

Jin: include fp16 vs int8 outputs for exemplars (first 3 lines) so labelers can judge hallucination vs phrasing.

Maya: agree. also want to expand gold for clusters where avg_bleu_delta <= -5 and cluster_size > 15: add +3 golden exemplars sampled for style diversity.

Kevin: we should also capture translation fidelity checks (named-entity preservation). add an heuristic: if NE match rate drops by >10% mark high priority.

Priya: copying actions: run normalized-hash + embed cluster @0.86, flag clusters by BLEU/NE drop, export CSV, request LabelOps 300 decisions (estimate). Omar please kick embeddings. Jin add diffs.

Omar: started run dedupe-q8x4-01 on shards 0/16. ETA 5h.

Jin: prepping diff snippets. will include NE diff counts.

Maya: Note: labelops only has limited capacity this sprint. if they push back we can do a micro-golden expansion auto for top 50 clusters (conservative sampling) and run a canary re-eval.

eval-bot: queued a micro-golden re-eval (200 examples) after labelops decisions are applied. run id mg-4012.

Kevin: sounds like a plan. once labelops decisions land, run micro-golden and then decide canary rollout. blockers: labelops bandwidth and a small compute bump for q8x4 canary.

Priya: CSV path will be s3://redwood-curation/q8x4_translation_triage.csv and s3://redwood-curation/qb-4012-diffs.csv. I'll post here when uploaded.

Omar: will post final cluster counts and total v100-hours used when run finishes.

Maya: thanks all. ping here when CSV + diffs are available and when labelops has ETA.

Priya: uploaded both CSVs to S3. linking now.

eval-bot: upload complete for qb-4012 diffs and q8x4 CSVs.

Kevin: ok to close for now. follow-ups: labelops schedule, micro-golden results, cost summary for the run.

Maya: closing loop later today with a short note in the model bring-up doc. thanks team!
